name: I work with
description: Who a practitioner works with: the session format, the age groups they see, and the life stages or communities they have experience with. Practitioners pick as many as apply.

items.label: Individuals
items.description: One-to-one sessions.

items.label: Couples
items.description: Two partners together, married or not.

items.label: Families
items.description: Two or more family members together.

items.label: Parent and child
items.description: A parent or caregiver and their child in sessions together.

items.label: Groups
items.description: Small therapy or support groups.

items.label: Young children
items.description: Early years, usually with a parent involved.

items.label: Children
items.description: Primary and middle school age.

items.label: Adolescents
items.description: Teenagers in secondary and higher secondary school.

items.label: Young adults
items.description: College years and early working life.

items.label: Adults
items.description: Working age and mid-life.

items.label: Older adults
items.description: Later life and retirement.

items.label: Premarital couples
items.description: Couples who are engaged or thinking about marriage.

items.label: Expecting parents
items.description: People who are pregnant, and their partners.

items.label: New mothers
items.description: Mothers in the first year or so after birth.

items.label: Mothers
items.description: Mums at any stage of motherhood.

items.label: Fathers
items.description: Dads at any stage of fatherhood.

items.label: Parents
items.description: Parents looking for support in raising their children.

items.label: Students
items.description: School and college students.

items.label: Working professionals
items.description: People balancing work pressure with the rest of life.

items.label: Caregivers
items.description: People looking after an ill, ageing or disabled family member.

items.label: LGBTQIA+ people
items.description: Queer-affirmative support for LGBTQIA+ people and their families.

items.label: Neurodivergent people
items.description: Autistic people, people with ADHD and other neurodivergent people.

items.label: People with disabilities
items.description: Disabled people and those with long-term health conditions.

items.label: NRIs & expats
items.description: Indians living abroad, and people who have moved to India.

items.label: Women
items.description: Concerns that come with being a woman, at home, at work and in society.

items.label: Men
items.description: A space for men to talk about what they usually keep to themselves.
